slots.jd.payments-startup.about: Brightpath Payments is building the payment infrastructure that small businesses rely on. As a Junior Backend Engineer, you'll work on the services that move money: keeping them fast, reliable and easy to build on. You'll ship real code early, pair with senior engineers who review your work, and pick up a lot about how payments systems hold up under pressure. If you like clear problems, honest feedback and a team that moves quickly, we'd love to hear from you.
slots.jd.payments-startup.duties:
What you'll do
- Help keep our payment services healthy and reliable, and join the on-call rotation with senior backup
- Track down slow queries and tune them so requests stay quick as traffic grows
- Design clean, well-documented APIs alongside more experienced engineers
- Plan and roll out API versioning so partners can upgrade without breaking changes
- Write follow-ups after incidents and turn what we learn into better runbooks
slots.jd.payments-startup.needs:
What we're looking for
- 1+ years of experience building or running backend services
- Comfort working in Linux environments and deploying to Kubernetes
- Some exposure to managing infrastructure as code with Terraform
- Working knowledge of Python and PostgreSQL, including reading query plans
- Familiarity with Elasticsearch for search or logging workloads
- Curiosity, clear communication and a willingness to ask for review
slots.r1.b1: Automates deployment pipeline steps for Kubernetes services, reducing average deployment time by 35 percent and cutting manual release work for the team.
slots.r1.b2: Writes incident follow-up notes and runbooks covering API versioning issues, helping on-call engineers trace breaking changes between endpoint versions.
slots.r1.b3: Tunes slow database queries using Docker-based local environments to reproduce production behaviour, reducing query response times by 35 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Designs and versions API endpoints in Spring Boot services, with a senior engineer reviewing each change before release.
slots.r1.i1: Supports service reliability for backend systems at Stonebridge Community Trust, sharing on-call duties and handling small, well-defined fixes under senior review.
slots.r1.i2: Works on API design and versioning for backend services at Stonebridge Community Trust, delivering small, well-scoped endpoint changes reviewed by senior engineers.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level backend engineer with about 1 year of experience building and maintaining services with Redis, GraphQL and Terraform. Works on small, well-defined parts of larger projects with a senior colleague reviewing, and holds a B.S. in Computer Science from Ridgeway College.
slots.summary.2: Backend software engineer at the entry level, with about 1 year of hands-on work using Redis for caching, GraphQL for APIs and Terraform for infrastructure. Takes on clearly scoped tasks, delivers them with review from senior engineers, and builds on a Computer Science degree from Ridgeway College.
